tests.name: ubjson_valueless_single_array_limit
tests.intent: Probes whether a single valueless UBJSON array exceeding max_valueless_container_size throws out_of_range exception.

tests.name: ubjson_valueless_cumulative_limit
tests.intent: Probes whether multiple smaller valueless UBJSON arrays exceeding the cumulative rate limit per byte are rejected.

tests.name: ubjson_noop_array_empty
tests.intent: Probes whether an optimized array of no-ops is reported and stored as empty regardless of a large declared count.

tests.name: ubjson_writer_fallback_valueless
tests.intent: Probes whether to_ubjson falls back to unoptimized form when valueless elements exceed the threshold.

tests.name: ubjson_valueless_type_t
tests.intent: Probes whether type 'T' (true) valueless arrays are correctly bounded by the cumulative element check.

tests.name: ubjson_valueless_type_f
tests.intent: Probes whether type 'F' (false) valueless arrays are correctly bounded by the cumulative element check.

tests.name: ubjson_sax_noop_count
tests.intent: Probes SAX parser behavior for no-op arrays, checking if start_array receives 0 elements.

tests.name: ubjson_payload_array_unaffected
tests.intent: Probes whether arrays with payload types (like int32 'l') are governed by standard size constraints rather than valueless cumulative limits.

tests.name: ubjson_small_valueless_array_base_allowed
tests.intent: Probes whether a small valueless array within the base limit is successfully accepted at the start of input.

tests.name: ubjson_objects_unaffected_by_valueless_limit
tests.intent: Probes whether JSON objects with many keys do not trigger valueless element charges.

tests.name: ubjson_valueless_exact_max_container_size
tests.intent: Probes a valueless array with exactly max_valueless_container_size (1048576) elements at the start of input.

tests.name: ubjson_valueless_one_over_max_container_size
tests.intent: Probes a valueless array with max_valueless_container_size + 1 elements, expecting an out_of_range exception.

tests.name: ubjson_multiple_small_valueless_arrays_within_rate
tests.intent: Probes multiple small valueless arrays whose total sum remains within the allowed rate per input byte.

tests.name: ubjson_mixed_valueless_and_payload_arrays
tests.intent: Probes an input containing both valueless typed arrays and payload-bearing arrays.

tests.name: ubjson_writer_cumulative_valueless_limit
tests.intent: Probes binary writer chunking mechanism when serializing multiple arrays of nulls sequentially.

tests.name: ubjson_noop_large_count_no_throw
tests.intent: Probes whether a no-op array with an extremely large count does not trigger an out_of_range exception.

tests.name: ubjson_empty_valueless_array
tests.intent: Probes an empty valueless array with zero count.

tests.name: ubjson_valueless_unoptimized_roundtrip
tests.intent: Probes round-trip serialization and deserialization of a manually constructed unoptimized valueless array representation.

tests.name: ubjson_valueless_multiple_types_cumulative
tests.intent: Probes cumulative element counting across different valueless types ('Z', 'T', 'F') in a single input.

tests.name: ubjson_valueless_invalid_type_marker
tests.intent: Probes reader behavior when encountering an invalid or unexpected type marker in optimized array header.

tests.name: ubjson_valueless_cumulative_limit_fixed
tests.intent: Probes whether multiple smaller valueless UBJSON arrays exceeding the cumulative rate limit per byte are rejected.

tests.name: ubjson_valueless_multiple_types_cumulative_fixed
tests.intent: Probes cumulative element counting across different valueless types ('Z', 'T', 'F') in a single input.

tests.name: test_saturating_limit_branch
tests.intent: Exercises the saturating limit branch when chars_read is extremely large so that limit calculation uses max_size.

tests.name: test_charge_valueless_elements_failure
tests.intent: Triggers out_of_range exception for excessive number of valueless elements exceeding the cumulative rate limit per byte read.

tests.name: test_enter_array_failure_hook
tests.intent: Exercises the enter_array failure path by providing invalid array framing or malformed continuation structure in UBJSON reader.

tests.name: test_binary_writer_valueless_fallback
tests.intent: Exercises binary writer valueless_array_fits and valueless_elements_written tracking by serializing arrays of nulls exceeding max_valueless_container_size in total.

tests.name: test_binary_writer_valueless_array_fits_inline
tests.intent: Directly evaluates binary writer serialization behavior on nested arrays of nulls to exercise the valueless type writing and fitting checks.
